title: test_channel_plan.py: Hash assertion uses computed value as fallback, making it tautological
description: Line 223: `expected_hash = out.get("hash_32", h)` defaults to the computed hash `h` when the key is missing. The assertion `h == expected_hash` then always passes. Malformed test vectors without `hash_32` keys will silently pass validation. Fix: require the key explicitly or fail the test when expected value is missing.
